title: Maximum power condition
description: Essential: States that power on R₀ is maximized when R₀ equals the equivalent resistance of the rest of the circuit (R+r = 100Ω).

title: Maximum power value
description: Essential: Correctly calculates maximum thermal power on R₀ as 1/16 W or 0.0625 W.

title: Minimum sum power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates minimum sum of thermal power on r and R as 0.01 W.

title: R power condition
description: Essential: States that power on R is maximized when R₀ = 0Ω.

title: Maximum R power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates maximum power on R as 0.225 W.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: Applies Ohm's law correctly to find current as I = E/(R₀+R+r).

title: Power expressions
description: Important: Derives correct power expressions using P=I²R for each resistor.

title: Maximization reasoning
description: Important: Uses mathematical methods (derivative or completing square) to find extremum conditions.

title: Units consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (Ω, V, W) throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in current
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign convention for current direction or power dissipation.

title: Maximum power misconception
description: Pitfall: Assumes maximum power transfer theorem applies to R instead of R₀ in part (1).

title: Algebraic manipulation error
description: Pitfall: Makes algebraic mistakes when simplifying power expressions or derivatives.
